sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (US-derived common law for corporate statutes; traditional customary law for land and family matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (1986, as amended in 2003)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) (in force 13 December 2020)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) between the United States and the Marshall Islands (signed 23 June 2008, in force 26 June 2008)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Marshall Islands Revised Statutes, Title 51, Chapter 3 (Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended), §§ 51.301 et seq.; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2013 (as amended); Marshall Islands Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulation 2017; Banking Act 1997 (as amended); Directive on Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions issued by the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each intended director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority in country of origin / Notary Public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) in the name of each UBO, director, and shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed utility service provider or regulated financial institution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Marshall Islands registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Grantor (individual or corporate entity) with notarial attestation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (where the shareholder is an existing corporate entity from a non-Hague jurisdiction)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the United Nations Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, FATF High-Risk and Monitored Jurisdictions Lists, UK HM Treasury sanctions list, and the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) domestic watchlist. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) are identified per FATF Recommendation 12 and subject to enhanced due diligence, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification. Screening determinations must be documented and retained for at least five years following termination of the business relationship (AML/CFT Act, s. 23).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Registrar of Business Organizations – Internal e-Reservation System (accessed exclusively through licensed Marshall Islands registered agents; no direct self-service public portal exists)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official business language. Corporate names must be rendered in the Roman/Latin alphabet. Names based on non-Roman scripts or the Marshallese language must be transliterated into English phonetics and accompanied by a certified English translation. Ampersands, punctuation, and special characters are not permitted except for common corporate designators.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Business Organizations within 14 working days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds for distinctiveness and, where applicable, attaching a notarized written consent from the holder of any deceptively similar registered name. If the rejection arises from a sensitive token, the appeal must annex prior written approval from the relevant ministry (e.g., Ministry of Finance for 'BANK', 'TRUST', or 'INSURANCE'). Unsuccessful administrative appeals may be appealed to the High Court of the Marshall Islands under the Administrative Procedure Act. Alternatively, a fresh reservation may be filed under a different name at any time. A name reservation may be renewed for two consecutive 30-day periods upon expiration; after such renewal period expires without incorporation, the name is released to the general registry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A non-resident Business Corporation is required to maintain a registered office at the physical street address of its licensed resident registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands (MIRS Title 51, Chapter 3, Business Corporations Act). A virtual office arrangement is acceptable in substance when the registered agent's physical office serves as the sole service-of-process address and all statutory records, including the beneficial ownership register, are physically available there. However, a virtual office may not be used to conceal the true business activities, and the registered agent must maintain suitable physical infrastructure to accept service of process and governmental correspondence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% per annum) for a low-risk subscription-box company with no local physical operations, local employees, or direct solicitation within the Marshall Islands. The risk escalates to 'Medium' (10–20% per annum) if the company establishes a physical marketing office, engages local merchants, or processes payments through Marshall Islands-licensed payment gateways.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Business Organizations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporations Act fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee for a Non-Resident Business Corporation (authorized capital up to USD 50,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Business Organizations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporations Act fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent service fee (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Marshall Islands licensed registered agent (corporate service provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard non-resident business corporation maintenance: USD 350–USD 1,500 depending on service scope

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/UBO compliance file and due diligence dossier (CDD/KYC and beneficial-ownership piercing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance officer of the licensed registered agent / corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional fee for Level-1 client due diligence, PEP screening, and beneficial-ownership analysis

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille processing (per package of up to 4 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent apostille authority in the jurisdiction of document origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Average notarial and legalization fee, including courier delivery, based on prevailing market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization contingency (for documents originating in non-Hague Apostille jurisdictions)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Embassy or Permanent Mission (Washington, D.C. / New York)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document consular fee as set by the RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act 1990 (Title 27, Marshall Islands Revised Code), as amended, §§ 10, 12, 26, 46, 52, and 75.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial Division, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Marshall Islands; filings accepted through an approved registered agent or the online corporate registry portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1) filed with the Registrar of Corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The corporation must have authorized share capital and may issue shares for lawful consideration; no escrow deposit or capital verification is required unless a specific promoter agreement imposes it.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts the share subscriptions described in the Articles of Incorporation and, upon receipt of lawful consideration, issues the subscribed shares to the subscribers named therein. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Corporation is established at the address set forth in the Articles, and the appointed registered agent is approved to serve in that capacity. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the individuals named in the organizational minutes are appointed President, Secretary, and Treasurer, with authority to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and make all filings necessary to carry out this resolution. This resolution takes effect immediately and remains in force until amended.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Majuro online name search and reservation portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a corporate name search to confirm the proposed name is distinguishable. File a name reservation request for 30 days with payment. Ensure no 'bank', 'trust', 'insurance', or other regulated terms are used.
required_dossiers: Copy of incorporator passport or government-issued ID
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, submit a revised name or request administrative review, attaching evidence of distinctiveness or consent from the conflicting entity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and notarize Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in the incorporating jurisdiction or international notarization accepted by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft Articles with the corporate name, lawful purpose, share structure, initial directors if desired, and registered office and agent. Have each incorporator sign and notarize the Articles. Prepare consents of proposed directors, officers, and registered agent.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent
Consent to act as director or officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry identifies defective notarization or missing statutory provisions, correct and re-execute the defective pages and request expedited re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial Division, Majuro, Marshall Islands, or an authorized online e-filing facility
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Articles of Incorporation and all statutory consents, pay the government filing fee, and obtain a stamped duplicate and Certificate of Incorporation. Verify the incorporation date and registration number.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or rejected, file a corrective amendment or answer the deficiency notice within 21 days; re-submit without duplicate fee if the error was registry-initiated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establish registered office and registered agent of record
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations registered agent unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that the registered office is a physical address in the Marshall Islands. Record the registered agent's appointment and consent in the registry and corporate minute book. Notify the agent of service-of-process duties.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent resigns or the registered office address becomes invalid, file the Appointment or Change of Registered Office and Agent form promptly and provide notice to all directors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation organizational governance and share issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office corporate records maintained for statutory inspection and registered agent recordal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the organizational meeting, adopt the first board resolution, issue share certificates to subscribers, prepare the stock ledger and minute book, record bank signatories, and confirm the registered agent details in the corporate records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any officer or director cannot serve, hold a special directors' meeting to appoint a replacement and amend the corporate records if required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — subscription-box retail and packaging activity does not trigger Marshall Islands industrial licensing; a foreign investment business license may separately apply if the owner holds non-resident status.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial or manufacturing operating license is required for ISIC 4791 remote retail subscription-box supply; only general business records and e-commerce payment compliance apply.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no significant environmental impact; no full EIA or environmental registration is required for non-manufacturing subscription-box logistics and warehousing activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or volatile organic compound emission sources are present; compliance with EPA solid-waste segregation rules and use of licensed municipal disposal for returned or unsold goods is required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For any leased office or packaging warehouse, obtain a fire safety inspection clearance and building occupancy certificate from the local jurisdiction; maintain minimum occupational safety conditions for packaging staff and keep exit and fire-suppression systems operational.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) Ministry of Finance, Revenue and Taxation Division, Majuro (direct tax administration under the Income Tax Act 1989, Title 54 MIRC); Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Business Corporations Act, Title 30 MIRC) for entity registration and NRDC status; RMI Customs Service (Ministry of Finance) for border duties via ASYCUDA World. No consolidated national tax portal exists; returns and license applications are filed in paper form with the Revenue and Taxation Division.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation (NRDC) engaging in no RMI trade or business and deriving no RMI-source revenue is not required to obtain an RMI TIN, business license, or gross revenue tax (GRT) registration; it obtains a corporate registration number and pays the statutory annual registry fee. If the entity later conducts business in the RMI, it must (1) obtain a Business License under the Business License Act 1989, (2) register with the Revenue and Taxation Division to obtain a TIN, and (3) file and pay the 3% GRT on RMI-source gross revenue. For any import/export movement, an importer/exporter registration number must be obtained from the RMI Customs Service. Note: the payload composite key cites iso_3 'PNG'; the official ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for the Marshall Islands is 'MHL'.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (statutory NRDC exemption from the 3% Gross Revenue Tax; RMI levies no income tax, capital gains tax, or net-worth tax, and its direct tax regime is territorial/source-based only)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box entity classification election and no hybrid-mismatch election exist under RMI law. The operative election is the statutory 'non-resident domestic corporation' (NRDC) designation made in the Articles of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act; continued exemption requires maintaining the statutory non-resident conditions (no RMI business activity, no RMI-resident shareholders, no RMI real property).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None. RMI has no value added tax, goods and services tax, or sales/use tax at any level of government; the only indirect-style national levy is customs import duty under the RMI Customs Service Act 1993. The 3% GRT is a direct tax on gross revenue derived from business conducted in the RMI, not an indirect tax. Under the described subscription-box model (offshore entity selling to non-RMI customers via Stripe/Authorize.Net, no RMI inventory or delivery), no RMI indirect-tax nexus arises.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST regime exists, hence no turnover threshold for indirect-tax registration. GRT and business-license obligations attach from the first dollar of revenue when a person is deemed to conduct business in the RMI; the RMI statutory currency is the United States dollar (USD).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. RMI imposes no electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API transmission, or digital stamping mandate for commercial invoices. The only electronic clearance channel is ASYCUDA World, which processes customs declarations (import and export) for the RMI Customs Service; GRT returns and business-license applications remain paper-based.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. Because RMI has no VAT/GST regime, there is no zero-rating (0%) mechanism for exported goods or offshore services, no input-VAT credit, and no export refund claim. RMI generally imposes no export duties; a customs export declaration serves statistical and control purposes only. No special export-incentive or free-zone tax regime is available to NRDCs under RMI law.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World) — required only where goods are physically exported from RMI territory; not a VAT zero-rating precondition
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill — carrier transport document for physical export movements; not a tax refund support document

Inward Remittance Certificate — not a recognized RMI statutory document; the RMI has no exchange controls and uses the USD as its domestic currency, so no bank-issued inward remittance certificate is required for export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export-VAT refund exists, so no refund clawback can arise. General RMI fiscal enforcement applies: false or fraudulent returns under the Income Tax Act 1989 (Title 54 MIRC) attract civil penalties, interest on unpaid GRT, and criminal fines; false customs declarations under the RMI Customs Service Act 1993 expose the importer/exporter to goods forfeiture and monetary penalties. Breach of the NRDC conditions is revocable retroactively, making the entity liable for GRT on RMI-source revenue for open years plus statutory penalties. The 180-day figure is a non-statutory commercial benchmark; RMI law imposes no FX repatriation deadline or exchange-control restriction.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Banking Commission (Financial Supervisory Authority) under the Ministry of Finance; no independent central bank is constituted, and the U.S. Dollar is adopted as the official legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands has no domestic currency or exchange control restrictions. Capital and current account transactions are fully convertible, and profit remittance or dividend distribution is freely transferable in U.S. Dollars subject only to standard corporate authorization documentation (board resolutions, audited financial statements where required) and anti-money laundering verification by the receiving correspondent bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The Marshall Islands imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation deadline for export receipts. Export earnings may be retained in foreign currency accounts offshore or deposited locally in U.S. Dollar accounts without restriction.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium. The Marshall Islands does not maintain a domestic electronic money institution (EMI) license; therefore a locally approved fintech/EMI is not available. Offshore digital EMIs or third-party payment processors (e.g., Stripe, Authorize.Net) may be used as commercial billing rails, but bank account opening and treasury clearing must be executed through a licensed international bank or a licensed local bank. Any non-deposit-taking EMI seeking to settle through correspondent accounts must demonstrate FATF-compliant licensing and comply with the receiving bank's AML/KYC due diligence.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No explicit statutory mandate requires physical presence; however, local banks generally require at least one director, or an authorized signatory under power of attorney, to attend an in-person KYC interview at the bank's office during initial account opening. Remote onboarding can be considered only if the entity is represented by a recognized Marshall Islands registered agent, the beneficial owner passes enhanced due diligence, and the bank approves a remote notarization or apostille process.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity arising from an offshore exempt business corporation structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation; registered agent certificate listing directors and shareholders; government-issued passports and proof of address of all beneficial owners; corporate organizational chart; signed certification of ultimate beneficial ownership; source of funds declaration and supporting asset documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity cross-border payment flows associated with recurring e-commerce subscription transactions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written explanation of the subscription box commercial model; executed master subscription terms and refund policy; historical and projected settlement reports from Stripe Billing and Authorize.Net; sample customer invoices and transaction logs; copy of the PCI-DSS attestation of compliance; information security policy document.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential misinterpretation of the tax-exempt status as a vehicle for tax evasion or money laundering
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Marshall Islands tax exemption certificate or ruling; latest annual return filed with the Registrar of Corporations; audited financial statements (if prepared); evidence of substantive business activities, including supplier contracts, fulfillment center agreements, and customer correspondence; clearance statement from the registered agent confirming compliance with the Business Corporations Act.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injections should be credited via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 wire transfers referencing the explicit purpose code 'Capital Contribution / Equity Investment' or equivalent bank classification. Supporting documents must include a board resolution approving the subscription, a signed share subscription agreement, a share register extract, and a source-of-funds statement from the remitting bank. No central bank approval is required; the receiving bank will apply standard OFAC and enhanced due diligence screening. For U.S.-based shareholders, convenient routing may use ACH or Fedwire into the corporate operating account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier payments for inventory, packaging, and freight are cleared via SWIFT MT103 international wire for overseas suppliers, or via domestic ACH/Fedwire for U.S. counterparties. For high-value purchase transactions, an irrevocable commercial Letter of Credit (UCP600) may be issued through the bank's correspondent network. Each disbursement must be matched with a purchase order, a supplier invoice, shipping documentation (Bill of Lading, courier receipts), and, where relevant, customs entry forms. All payments must include correct purpose codes and be retained for audit under the AML/CTF internal controls.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards transacted with licensed international banks or U.S. broker-dealers
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) settled in USD against currencies of non-convertible or thinly traded markets
Cross-currency interest rate swaps and plain-vanilla FX swaps for balance sheet hedging of long-duration subscription inventory commitments
FX spot contracts for immediate conversion of receipts into USD operating cash

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report (Business Corporations Act annual return, franchise/tax-status renewal, and registered agent confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Maritime and Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May each calendar year; the Registrar's annual administrative filing window for all Registered Agents opens in April and closes on 31 May
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A statutory late penalty is assessed after 31 May, with additional administrative fees if the report remains unfiled during the cure period; continued non-filing after notice permits the Registrar to administratively strike off or dissolve the company and forfeit limited liability protections

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit threshold for a non-resident, privately held Business Corporation. There is no revenue, asset, or headcount test that compels an independent audit. An audit is mandatory only if the company's articles or bylaws require it, if shareholders holding the necessary voting power approve an audit, or if a court orders an audit for cause in connection with shareholder or creditor relief.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: RMI has no codified Local GAAP. Financial statements are ordinarily prepared in U.S. dollars under IFRS or U.S. GAAP, and the Business Corporations Act requires books and records to fairly reflect transactions and financial condition. Tax-basis reporting is not required because the non-resident Business Corporation is tax-exempt in the Marshall Islands.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Registered Agent must obtain an annual beneficial ownership confirmation before the 31 May filing deadline. The confirmation identifies all natural persons holding 25% or more ownership or effective control, records any share transfers made during the year, and verifies that the Register of Members has been updated for each transfer. The confirmation is retained by the Registered Agent for AML/CFT purposes and is produced to the Registrar only upon lawful request; it is not a publicly searchable filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (including share transfer and redemption ledger)
Accounting records and underlying transaction documents

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$1,500 – US$4,000 if the company voluntarily obtains a certified audit; no statutory audit is required

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - non-resident domestic Business Corporations are exempt from income tax under the Income Tax Act 1989 (as amended); the Republic only taxes income derived from Marshall Islands sources by persons carrying on trade or business within the Republic.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption for non-resident BCs from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, branch profit tax, and any withholding tax; no VAT/GST or sales tax applies to subscription-box revenues; tax-exemption certificates confirm a zero effective rate, leaving only BCA annual report fees and registration charges.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No income tax return is obligatory for exempt non-resident BCs. The sole recurring statutory filing is the BCA Section 47 Annual Corporate Report, submitted through the Registrar of Corporations' electronic registry via a licensed Resident Agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the month in which the anniversary of incorporation falls; the minimum annual report fee (approximately USD 250, scaled to authorized share capital) must accompany the filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Corporate Legal Name and File Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact name as shown on the certificate of incorporation and the RMI file number assigned by the Registrar.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the full registered name; do not abbreviate unless the certificate itself does.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, RMI street address, and license number of the agent authorized to accept service of process.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain a licensed RMI resident agent at all times; provide the agent's physical address, not a foreign address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office in the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the agent's physical office in Majuro or Ebeye; a P.O. box alone is impermissible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, par value, and classes; this determines the statutory annual fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State authorized capital accurately to avoid underpayment and subsequent penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and residential addresses of all directors and officers in office at the filing date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals are permitted; postal addresses are acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Concise narrative of the company's actual commercial operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'non-resident subscription-box e-commerce; no Marshall Islands-source income' to preserve the tax-exempt status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the BC is in good standing, has not transacted local business, and has not engaged in an ESR 'relevant activity' without proper notification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Make the attestation only if factually accurate; false attestation exposes signatories to criminal penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of an authorized director or officer, printed name, and date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Electronic signature is accepted when filed through the resident agent's portal.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing accrues a monthly delinquency penalty on the unpaid annual fee in accordance with the Registrar's published fee schedule; prolonged non-payment (typically six months) authorizes the Registrar to revoke the certificate of incorporation, and persons acting on the corporation's behalf after revocation are personally liable on corporate obligations.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - no withholding tax is imposed on dividends paid by a Marshall Islands Business Corporation to resident or non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Inapplicable: the Republic has not concluded an integrated network of double taxation agreements. Only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) exist (e.g., with the United States, Australia, New Zealand, and certain Nordic/European states), which do not confer withholding relief. No TRC submission or reduced-rate protocol is available; repatriation is tax-free at source and governed solely by the shareholder's home jurisdiction (e.g., US Subpart F/GILTI rules).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on cross-border interest and IP royalty payments to non-residents; no treaty rates exist.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act does not enact arm's-length transfer pricing rules, local/master-file thresholds, or contemporaneous documentation obligations; USD is the local currency. Tax-exempt non-resident BCs have no TP compliance duty, though intercompany transactions must be commercially genuine to withstand home-jurisdiction CFC and substance challenges.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations 2019 (as amended) apply only to non-resident domestic corporations conducting 'relevant activities' (banking, insurance, maritime shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centre, IP holding, and pure holding company operations). ISIC 4791 subscription-box retail is generally outside scope unless the entity is characterized as a 'distribution and service centre', in which case the BC must file an annual substance notification, keep all relevant books and records within the Republic, conduct core income-generating activities there, and demonstrate adequate premises, employees, and expenditure; penalties attach to non-compliance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion at the beneficial-owner level
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the RMI BC as a booking vehicle to misattribute recurring subscription revenue, omitting foreign reportable income, or asserting RMI 'tax residence' without factual management in Majuro.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI: certificate revocation and TIEA-based information exchange; home jurisdictions: back taxes, accuracy or fraud penalties (e.g., US IRC Section 6663 fraud penalty of 75%), and compound interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution for unpaid taxes, asset freezes, travel bans, and imprisonment for tax fraud (e.g., US IRC Sections 7201/7206 - up to 5 years per count).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a false ESR declaration or operating a distribution or service-centre 'relevant activity' with zero local substance, bare-nominee directors, or no management control in the Republic.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registrar penalties for each failure, daily penalties for continued non-compliance, loss of tax-exemption certification, and administrative strike-off of the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations incur personal fines and disqualification; trading after strike-off creates personal liability for all post-dissolution debts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing subscription payments for sanctioned parties, accepting criminal proceeds through RMI bank or e-money rails, or circumventing Customer Due Diligence conducted by the resident agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to USD 2,000,000 per violation under the Anti-Money Laundering Act 2011 (as amended), asset forfeiture, and mandatory suspicious-transaction reporting to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment (commonly up to 10-15 years), personal monetary penalties, and extradition for directors knowingly engaged in laundering subscription-fraud proceeds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Two consecutive years of unpaid annual fees, lapse of the licensed resident agent, or abandonment of the BCA annual report obligation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registrar's notice and revocation of the certificate of incorporation; reinstatement requires settlement of all arrears, penalties, and a reinstatement fee.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: After revocation, officers and directors purporting to contract on behalf of the BC are jointly and severally liable on those contracts; unlawful distributions are clawed back.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly signing a false statement of status, business description, or ESR notification to conceal related-party pricing, local activity, or ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Misdemeanor prosecution under the BCA, criminal fines, Registrar discretionary strike-off, and unlimited limitation periods for fraud by concealment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal fines, civil damages to creditors and the Registrar, and travel restrictions when mutual legal assistance or extradition is sought.
